description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Aria Mode] and [More the Merrier Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Aria Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 2] after using four Spellblade abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: More the Merrier Mode
description.text: Casts Metamorphosis after using Spellblade Tranquility, removed after triggering
